tools.detail: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash (macOS/Linux/WSL); Windows PowerShell and CMD variants listed

claims: No coding knowledge needed to install
Installer prints 'Claude Code successfully installed!' and 'Installation complete!'
how_to_steps: Open the Claude Code docs quickstart and copy the install line for your OS
Open Terminal, paste the line, hit Enter; wait for 'Setting up Claude Code...' then the green success message
Type 'claude' and Enter; answer the permission/trust prompt with 1 (Yes)
on_screen_only: Overlay 'Easiest Way To Set Up Claude Code'

Terminal: 'noevarner@Mac ~ % curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash', 'Setting up Claude Code...', 'Claude Code successfully installed!', 'Location: ~/.local/bin/claude', 'Next: Run claude --help to get started', 'Installation complete!'
